violations.affected_code:
Image(
            image: image,
            fit: BoxFit.contain,
            errorBuilder: ...
          )
violations.explanation: The Image widget has no semanticLabel and the component provides no way to pass an alternative text description. Screen reader users cannot learn what the clinical illustration or photograph depicts; only the generic title (default 'Image') is announced in the app bar.

Zooming and panning rely solely on pinch and drag gestures. No buttons or semantic actions are provided for users who cannot perform multi-finger gestures or who use assistive technologies such as switch access or screen readers.
The default title 'Image' is generic and gives screen reader users no meaningful context about the content shown when callers omit a title.
